node.title: Re: Win::OLE Excel: disable macros
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The documentation of [https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/excel.workbooks.open#remarks|Workbooks.Open] says:

By default, macros are enabled when opening files programmatically. Use the [https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/excel.application.automationsecurity|AutomationSecurity] property to set the macro security mode used when opening files programmatically.

This works for me:

use warnings; use strict; use Win32::OLE (); use Win32::OLE::Const 'Microsoft Excel'; $Win32::OLE::Warn = 3; # die on errors my $Excel = Win32::OLE->new('Excel.Application', 'Quit') or die "Failed to open Excel"; # or to get running Excel instance: Win32::OLE->GetActiveObject('Excel.Application') my $const = Win32::OLE::Const->Load('Microsoft Office '.$Excel->{Version}.' Object Library'); $Excel->{AutomationSecurity} = $const->{msoAutomationSecurityForceDisable}; $Excel->{Visible} = 1; my $Book = $Excel->Workbooks->Open("filename.xlsm"); $Book->Activate; # ... $Excel->Quit;
